text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With this, finally... that's 50 sprints 
done...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
M-My body feels so heavy... My legs are 
all wobbly...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
T-The scale... isn't broken, is it...? Why 
have I gained so much weight!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No... I have to lose weight!! Without 
anyone finding out...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"If I start sniffling here, I'll never 
become a top Umadol!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally, definitely gonna get back my 
cute body! I'll reclaim the "Cute Falco" 
no matter what!

Afterward, Smart Falcon's hard work paid 
off, and her diet was a success...!
